verdict.rationale: Filee's conversion engine runs entirely on your own machines: it is MIT open source, works offline on Windows and Linux, and can be built from source with .NET 10. It ships a first-party CLI (`filee convert` with `--json` output and defined exit codes), plus silent and portable installs, so it can be scripted inside your own environment. However, the evidence shows no embeddable library API, no container image and no server or daemon mode, and no OpenAPI endpoint was found, so the engine is only usable as a desktop app plus CLI. Missing for 10: documented library/SDK for embedding, official container image, self-hosted server/API mode, headless server deployment guidance.
